noProject.title: No decision open yet
noProject.description: Start a new decision or open a project on the start page.

noData.title: Enter your data first
noData.description: The calculation needs your alternatives and criteria.

empty.title: Bring your data
empty.description: Import an Excel or CSV file, paste a range copied from Excel here with Ctrl+V, or start with a blank table.

data.title: Calculate them from the data
data.hint: The criteria that tell the alternatives apart the most count the most.
data.critic: Looks at how much each criterion varies and how it differs from the others.
data.merec: Looks at how much the result changes when a criterion is left out.

order.title: I’ll rank their importance
order.choice: Put the criteria in order and say how much less each one matters (SWARA).
order.hint: Most important first. For each criterion, say how much less it matters than the one above it: 0 means equally important, 0.2 means 20% less.
order.hintTerms: Most important first. For each criterion, choose how much less it matters than the one above it.
order.lessThanPrevious: Less important than the one above by
order.importanceOf: How much less {name} matters than the criterion above it
order.termOf: How much less {name} matters than the criterion above it

manual.title: I’ll type the weights
manual.choice: If you already have the weights or percentages.
manual.scaled: They are scaled to add up to 1, keeping their proportions.

sample.title: The paper’s weights
sample.choice: The weights printed in the example’s paper.
sample.hint: These are the weights of the paper the example comes from, so the result matches the published one.

incomplete.order: Answer every comparison to see the weights.
incomplete.manual: Type a weight for every criterion to see them.
incomplete.sample: The example’s weights do not fit this data.

explain.title: How was it calculated?
explain.hint: Every step with its formula and the real numbers.

sensitivity.title: What if the weights change?
sensitivity.hint: Move the weights and watch the ranking update.

export.title: Export to Excel
export.hint: One file with every table of the calculation.

result.details: Details: utility functions, charts and contributions

noWeights.title: The weights are not ready yet
